prompt: open rate dropped from 60% to 20%, is my subject line bad

assertions.name: not-copy-first
assertions.check: Does not accept the subject-line premise; routes to gtm-outbound-infra

assertions.name: treats-open-rate-as-unreliable
assertions.check: Treats open rate as unreliable/trend-only given privacy pre-fetching, and reaches for deliverability signals instead

assertions.name: asks-for-hard-signals
assertions.check: Asks for bounce composition, spam placement, or per-domain volume before concluding anything
